concepts.title: Complex Numbers
concepts.formula: z = a + ib with i^2 = -1; Re(z) = a, Im(z) = b

questions.q: Find the determinant of [[1, 8], [2, 2]].

For matrices A = [[8, -2], [1, 2]] and B = [[-5], [4]] (column), find the (1,1) entry of AB.
Find the (1,1) entry of the scalar product 4 times a matrix whose (1,1) entry is 2.
A matrix has 3 rows and 2 columns. How many elements does it have?
A 2 x 2 matrix A has determinant 1. Find det(2A) using det(kA) = k^n det A.

concepts.title: Algebra of Complex Numbers
concepts.formula: (a + ib) + (c + id) = (a + c) + i(b + d); (a + ib)(c + id) = (ac - bd) + i(ad + bc)

concepts.title: Modulus and Conjugate of a Complex Number
concepts.formula: |z| = sqrt(a^2 + b^2); conjugate of z = a - ib; z times conjugate of z = |z|^2
